query: Which components does InterviewForge use for document retrieval?

sources.text:
Public Project Notes — Sample Knowledge Vault Document
AgentForge AI connects React and FastAPI to document Q&A and multi-agent workflows.
LangGraph routes requests to document retrieval or MCP tools.
CrewAI coordinates agents for research, analysis and review.
InterviewForge AI offers document Q&A, mock interviews and Python study.
It ingests PDFs, chunks text, creates embeddings and uses persistent ChromaDB storage.
Its application retrieves the top three chunks for local Llama 3.2 answers through Ollama.
Practice sessions have five questions with scores from zero to ten, feedback and hints.
NewsPulse collects RSS articles, deduplicates stories and groups headlines by meaning.
It produces source-attributed briefings with LangChain and Claude.
Pydantic validates structured output and optional LangSmith tracing supports debugging.
